stem: \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{vmatrix}\). Write the degree of the given determinant.
solution: The given determinant \(\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{vmatrix}\) has two rows and two columns, so it is a determinant of order (degree) \(2\).

stem: From the following equations which one is the quadratic equation?
solution: A quadratic equation has degree \(2\). \(x(x + 5) = 2 \Rightarrow x^2 + 5x - 2 = 0\), which is of degree \(2\). Option A gives \(5 - 3x = x^3\) (degree 3), option C is linear, and option D gives \(x + 2 = x^3\) (degree 3). Hence option B is the quadratic equation.

stem: Find the common difference of the following A.P.: \(4, 4, 4, \ldots\)
Which number cannot represent a probability?
solution: The probability of an event always lies between \(0\) and \(1\) (both inclusive). \(\dfrac{15}{10} = 1.5 > 1\), so it cannot represent a probability. \(\dfrac{2}{3} \approx 0.67\), \(15\% = 0.15\) and \(0.7\) all lie in \([0, 1]\).

stem: If \(2x + y = 7\) and \(x + 2y = 11\), then find the value of \(x + y\).
solution: Add the two equations: \((2x + y) + (x + 2y) = 7 + 11 \Rightarrow 3x + 3y = 18 \Rightarrow 3(x + y) = 18 \Rightarrow x + y = 6\).

stem: Find the first term of the given sequence: \(t_n = 3n - 4\).
How many alpha numerals are there in the format of GSTIN?
solution: A GSTIN (GST Identification Number) is made up of \(15\) alpha-numeral characters.

stem: Two coins are tossed simultaneously. Write the sample space \(S\).
solution: When two coins are tossed simultaneously, the sample space is \(S = \{HH, HT, TH, TT\}\), so \(n(S) = 4\).
